sources.summary: Dezeen Showroom: oak surfaces with a timeless appearance define interior design studio Vermland's modular kitchens, which are handmade in Denmark. Founded in Copenhagen by cabinetmakers Joakim Tolf Vulpius and Anton Bak, Vermland aims to make kitchens that are long-lasting in terms of both durability and style.
